RESULT_STATUS: complete
# Independent review findings

1. **P1 — quoted Coverage can approve a review with no real Coverage section.** `lib/review_verdict.py:62-76` scans raw lines without excluding fenced quotations, and counts metadata as section body. Reproductions: `APPROVED\nFindings:\n```markdown\nCoverage\nReviewed all changed files\n```\n` and `APPROVED\nCoverage\nRESULT_STATUS: complete\n` both make `review_verdict.approves()` return True. Thus `lib/task_record.py:609` can accept a hashed review with no genuine Coverage report, and `agent/extensions/dispatcher.ts:706-727` can clear its gate; the same shared result incorrectly marks completeness in `bin/tp-agent`, routing evaluations, and collect notices. Fix the shared parser to recognize an actual unquoted section outside code fences and require substantive coverage content (exclude RESULT_STATUS / boilerplate), then regression-test each consumer with these inputs. A heading preceding the first verdict line is already rejected by `parse()` and was checked.

2. **P2 — routing evaluations bypass the shared verdict parser and export refused input as APPROVED.** `lib/routing_evals.py:396-405` checks only `first_line_verdict()` and `coverage_problem()` instead of `assess()`. `APPROVED\nRESULT_STATUS: REQUEST_CHANGES\nCoverage\nreviewed src/a.py\n` raises ValueError in `assess()` but `task_summary()` exports `{'verdict':'APPROVED'}`. This is the only other independently implemented verdict interpretation found; `dispatcher.ts:171-182` has its own first-line parser but additionally invokes the Python CLI for completeness before approving. Have routing evals call `assess()` on the full text and refuse on ValueError/read failures; test contradictory and malformed full replies so no summary/count treats them as approval.

3. **P2 — collect/inspect can describe an unparseable or missing review result as complete.** `bin/tp-agent:100-105,126-139` takes RESULT_STATUS directly from the text and only forces `incomplete` for successfully parsed verdicts missing Coverage; for `APPROVED\nRESULT_STATUS: complete\nCoverage\nreviewed a.py\nRESULT_STATUS: REQUEST_CHANGES`, `record()` reports `result_status='complete'`, `verdict='unparseable'` and `review_complete=False` with no review notice. An absent result file also bypasses assessment altogether. No approval gate directly relies on this field, but collect and the injected index incorrectly present a completed review. Normalize all review assessment failures to incomplete with an explicit reason/notice; test missing and unparseable collect/index rows. Check the analogous missing-result presentation in both collect_result tools (`agent/extensions/subagents.ts:79-85`, `claude/mcp/subagents.mjs:33-39`), which skip notices if reply is empty.

Verification: `python3.12 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_review_coverage.py'`, `test_review_verdict.py`, `test_routing_evals.py` passed (12, 9, 24 tests). Reproduced defects via Python calls to `assess`, `approves`, and `routing_evals.task_summary`. `git diff --check` passed. `bash tests/check_dispatcher_types.sh` blocked by missing Pi Node package/types (`Install Pi with its Node types or set PI_CODING_AGENT_PACKAGE`). No files in project modified; no live worker or full suite executed.
